Step 3. Consider the rational operator \(T_{1460013}\) acting on the functional space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the rational-functional decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1460013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1460013}\).
